_comment: #2301 grandfathered Semgrep findings, keyed ruleId::file with occurrence count. A finding in a NEW file, a new rule, or MORE occurrences than `count` FAILS CI. Each entry needs a written `reason`. Prune entries as files get fixed. Regenerate preserving reasons: node scripts/check-semgrep-baseline.mjs semgrep.sarif --update

entries.reason: add_header calls inside location blocks intentionally re-assert security headers that nginx semantics drop when a nested block sets its own. Review of nginx-production.conf shows the overrides are deliberate; not a vulnerability.
Same as deploy/nginx/nginx-production.conf: location-block add_header duplicates are the documented way to keep security headers on responses that define per-location headers. Deliberate, reviewed.

Backup-verification cron spawns a fixed pg_restore/gpg command line built only from operator-controlled env vars (no request/user input reaches the command string). Pre-existing at ratchet introduction (#2301).
Local operator-only script (git invocations with constant arguments). Not reachable from any request path. Pre-existing at ratchet introduction (#2301).
Local operator-only disaster-recovery script; command strings are constants plus env-supplied paths, never user input. Pre-existing at ratchet introduction (#2301).
Local operator-only backup verification script; constant commands, no user-controlled input. Pre-existing at ratchet introduction (#2301).

AES-256-GCM with the auth tag explicitly verified via decipher.setAuthTag() before final() (Node rejects tampered ciphertext). authTagLength option is omitted but fixed at 16 for all stored ciphertexts; declaring it in options would change nothing behaviorally. Pre-existing format constraint (#2301).

Same pattern as lib/backups/encrypt.ts: createDecipheriv + explicit setAuthTag(); GCM tag is enforced at final(). Rule flags the missing options arg, but authentication is applied. Pre-existing at ratchet introduction (#2301).

Email-template preview renders through sanitizeHTML() (DOMPurify, lib/sanitize.ts) before dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Sanitizer call is the project-standard defense; flagged because the value is a function result. Pre-existing at ratchet introduction (#2301).
